description: Upcoming US macro DATA-RELEASE DATES (a schedule, not estimates) for the 8 tracked releases (CPI, Employment Situation, GDP, Jobless Claims, PCE, PPI, Industrial Production, Retail Sales). Returns {days, events, count, withheld, source_status, error}; each event is {date, event, release_id, release_name, label_source}: release_name is FRED's OWN name; event is our label only when label_source is 'ol'. No values; no FOMC dates. `days` default 90; above 180 is REFUSED. ALWAYS CHECK source_status: every failure returns events=[], like a quiet calendar. Cached 6h. Source: FRED releases/dates. Needs a free Oxford Ledge API key that the client's operator configures.

days.description: Number of days to look ahead (default 90)

name: get_economic_calendar
title: Economic Calendar
